hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was turned on at 22:34, and the new code path divides by zero on account page rendering, producing a ~27-36% error rate. Logs show the flag flipping from a steady `off` to a mixed `off 67 / on 133` ramp in the onset minute, then fully `on`, exactly coincident with the appearance of ZeroDivisionError.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: a code release introduced the faulty division and the flag evaluation change merely reflects it. The change log shows no deploy in the 24h before onset, so this is unsupported but would explain the same ZeroDivisionError if an unrecorded rollout occurred at 22:34.
